$comment: Accepted high/critical advisories for scripts/audit-check.mjs (FND-5). Each entry needs id (GHSA), package, reason and the backlog item that removes it. Review at every release (docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md). electron is not listed: it is a devDependency and the gate audits shipped libraries only; its upgrade is SEC-1 (WP1).

entries.reason: Pulled in by fastify 4 (fast-json-stringify, ajv-formats); goes away with the fastify 5 upgrade.

entries.title: find-my-way: DDoS with HTTP2
entries.reason: fastify 4 router; the advisory needs HTTP/2, which the remote-control server does not enable. Goes away with fastify 5.

entries.title: lodash vulnerable to Code Injection via `_.template` imports key names
entries.reason: Only _.template is affected; discord.js reaches lodash through @sapphire/shapeshift, which uses lodash/get and lodash/uniqWith only. Fix: lodash 4.17.24+ via a resolution or a discord.js update.

entries.title: proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet
entries.reason: Used by fastify only when trustProxy is set; the remote-control server leaves it unset. Goes away with fastify 5.
